title: Identity Theft
grade_or_penalty: 2nd degree if $75,000+ or 5 or more victims; 3rd degree if $500 to under $75,000 or 2-4 victims; 4th degree if under $500 or one victim
key_points: Impersonating another or assuming a false identity, or using another's personal identifying information, to obtain a benefit or injure or defraud someone.
